An operating system manages different types of processes. Each process has a process ID and a burst time (the time required by the process to complete execution).
Create an abstract class Process with:
- processId – stores the process ID.
- burstTime – stores the burst time.

- A concrete method displayDetails() to display the process information.

Execution Time = Burst Time + 2 ms context switching time

Process ID
Burst Time

Burst Time: <burstTime> ms

10
